# FLX-3601: the consumers block is not a mapping of the keys it carries

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A Simulation declares its consumers' questions under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].consumers, a mapping that carries dialect, asOf, tables, prefixes, columns, views, queries, limits, calibration and compiledWith (the sqlglot version that compiled the requirements fluxsim init applied) and nothing else. The block is read with the exact YAML reader's conventions: a key it does not carry is refused rather than ignored, since a declaration nothing reads goes missing without anyone noticing. Fix the block named in the message.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3601
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
